text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll drop off your birthday 
present later. Make sure you stay in your 
room!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Got it, Hishiama. Man, you're always so 
direct.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You know, it's totally fine to make it an 
anonymous surprise present once in a 
while, too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Even without a single clue, I'll prove 
I can guess that it's a gift from you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hah, no thanks, that sounds like a pain. 
Besides, it's not like I'm giving a 
present just because I felt like it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm giving you this present because I want 
to see you smile.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Let me celebrate with you in person. 
After all, it's my once-a-year treat to 
see that cute little look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, looks like you've scored a point on 
me. Understood, I shall wait quietly in my 
room.
